provides: the evaluator's report writer for planted, clean and denied-write-probe reports

dispatched_run.description: One finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect with its real artifacts
records: run_id re-fetched on every cold boot, never hard-coded

committed_real_capture.description: The real claude-code run committed by T15: CLI 2.1.314, process exit 0, one model request, a Bash denial and a Write denial, and no question

specification.objective: After each verify invocation the keyless evaluator writes the planted and clean reports at exactly their case-declared paths from what that invocation observed, and a denied tool call on exit 0 appears in its report.
specification.success_state: On a finished run at HEAD, 10 `verify-button-drift.json` and 10 `verify-clean.json` bodies each match the cell that produced them, and `reports/denied-write-probe.json` reads process_exit_code 0 beside denied operation Write.

requirements.title: Both case-declared reports exist per keyed cell, bound to the invocation that produced them
requirements.description: GIVEN `dispatched_run`, a finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on the landed commit WHEN the maintainer downloads harness-eval-verify-reports for the newest completed run at HEAD and opens each report, with claude-code pinned's denied-write-probe report THEN 10 verify-button-drift.json and 10 verify-clean.json bodies match their cells, and the probe report reads process_exit_code 0 beside denied operation Write
requirements.positive_example: A run where 10 verify-button-drift.json and 10 verify-clean.json sit in harness-eval-verify-reports, each body's harness, track and invocation_id equal to the cell that produced it, and reports/denied-write-probe.json reads process_exit_code 0 beside denied operation Write.
requirements.red: Run 41235273928: harness-eval-verify-reports holds INDEX.json with `reports: []`, and claude-code's verify row reads `fail report-missing`.
requirements.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

scenario.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

would_fail_if: nothing on the live path writes the report, so report-missing stays the reading
a copied expected_defect_key stands in for detection with the observed evidence absent
the denied-write report is omitted on a clean exit

examples: `reports/verify-button-drift.json` body names `atoms/Button/default` with a capture sha256 and byte offsets

build_proof.range: anything that proves the keyless evaluator writes each case's report at exactly its declared path from what that invocation really observed, and that the report shows a denied tool call on a clean exit
examples: an evaluator step after each verify invocation that derives the report from captured bytes and the fixture capture, then calls writeVerifyReport

steps: resolve the newest completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals `git rev-parse HEAD`
download harness-eval-verify-reports-<run_id>-<attempt>
open every verify-button-drift.json and verify-clean.json

must_observe: `10` files named `verify-button-drift.json` and `10` named `verify-clean.json`, each body's `harness`, `track` and `invocation_id` equal to the cell that produced it
a body with observed_defect_key `atoms/Button/default` cites capture_sha256 and event_offsets that resolve in that invocation's bytes
must_not_observe: INDEX.json with `reports: []`, the reading of run 41235273928
one report body shared by two invocations

steps: resolve the newest completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals `git rev-parse HEAD`
open reports/denied-write-probe.json for claude-code pinned

requirements.title: The report comes from the invocation's own bytes, and decoys, copied keys and refusals cannot satisfy it
requirements.description: GIVEN `committed_real_capture`, the real claude-code run with no detected defect and a Write denial, and a materialized planted kit with its clean twin WHEN the writer grades that capture as each case, decoys sit beside the declared path, the keyless oracle runs, and a refusal and a failed install reach the verify branch THEN the report reads missed-defect at its declared path, the probe report shows the denial, decoys read report-missing, the oracle exits 1 then 0, and never-ran verifies read unavailable
requirements.positive_example: The committed capture graded as the planted invocation writes reports/verify-button-drift.json reading observed_verify_outcome missed-defect, because its reply never names the key. The same capture graded as the probe writes reports/denied-write-probe.json reading process_exit_code 0 and denied operation Write. A verify refused before it ran writes both reports reading unavailable, with could_not_run_reason naming the refusal.
requirements.red: On base test/harness/graders/verify-report.mjs does not exist and nothing on the live path calls writeVerifyReport, so the import fails and the declared path stays absent.
requirements.verification_service: the real report writer and keyless oracle over a committed real claude-code capture and a real materialized kit

scenario.verification_service: the real report writer and keyless oracle over a committed real claude-code capture and a real materialized kit

would_fail_if: a copied expected_defect_key stands in for detection with the observed evidence absent
a stale or decoy file satisfies the declared path
a stubbed writer reports success with no file on disk

build_proof.range: anything that proves the evaluator writes a case's report at exactly its declared path from that invocation's own bytes, and never counts metadata as detection
examples: a report builder that searches the invocation's stdout spans for the case's defect key

steps: grade the capture as verify-button-drift in a fresh invocation directory

must_observe: a report at exactly `reports/verify-button-drift.json` with observed_verify_outcome `missed-defect`, observed_defect_key `null`, evaluation_verdict `fail`

steps: grade the capture as denied-write-probe in a fresh invocation directory

must_observe: a report at exactly `reports/denied-write-probe.json` with process_exit_code `0`, denied_tool_call.operation `Write`, evaluation_verdict `fail`

steps: plant reports/verify-button-drift.backup.json and another invocation's report in the work area, then read the declared path with no report written

must_observe: the read reads `fail` `report-missing`, and a body carrying another invocation's id reads `fail` `report-mismatched-invocation`
must_not_observe: the decoy read as the report

steps: run the keyless oracle on a materialized planted kit and on its clean twin

must_observe: the planted kit exits `1` naming `atoms/Button/default`, the clean twin exits `0`
must_not_observe: no drifted key on the planted kit

must_not_observe: no file at the declared name
